section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a single study conducted in Iran involving university students. Data were collected between December 2014 and June 2015 from seven large universities in Tehran using a paper-and-pencil survey method. The BAS-2 was translated into Persian following a rigorous translation and back-translation protocol, and participants completed the questionnaire anonymously in classroom settings on a voluntary basis.
